archived.description: true to archive the grant: no month is proposed for it again.

expense_account.description: The expense account the monthly expense is debited to.

fair_value.description: The fair value of a share at the grant date, in the base currency, at most six decimals: measured once, never remeasured.

recipient.description: Who the shares are granted to.

reserve_account.description: The equity account (the share-based payment reserve) it is credited to; never share capital.

service_start.description: The first day of the month the service starts.

tranches.description: The tranches: each has its own service period, from the service start to its vest day's month.

valuation.description: Where the fair value comes from, such as the valuation report and its date [verify valuation].
